test.rule: last 40 sessions: top 30% vs the S&P on its down days (-0.5% or worse), top half on its up days (+0.5% or better), within 15% of the 52-week high
test.forward: 63 sessions (3 months) and 126 sessions (6 months, in m6), vs the average stock of the list

episodes.rule: S&P 500 falls of 7.000000000000001% or more, high to low (closes). Groups measured on the same dates for every stock; next 3 and 6 months vs the average stock of the list. Today's list of US stocks: survivorship bias.

groupsTest.rule: groups of 4+ stocks ranked by the median RS score of their stocks, every 20 sessions; mean of (stock - average stock) per date, in %; beat = share of dates above the average stock

holyGrail.rule: first touch of the 20-day EMA in an uptrend, entry the next day above the high of the touch bar. strong = ADX(14) above 30 in the last 10 sessions, weak = under 20, mid = between. dN = return N sessions after the entry day close, minus the average stock (%). targetFirst / stopFirst = last 20-day high or the swing low reached first, within 20 sessions (% of trades)
